detail.longDescription: Redoubt is a small kit that turns the machine you already own into your own private cloud. Photos, files, search, ad blocking, remote access, one dashboard. Zero BigTech, zero telemetry. github.com/tryredoubt/redoubt codeberg.org/tryredoubt/redoubt Your data has been sleeping in someone else's house long enough. Time to bring it home. # homelab # selfhosted # privacy # opensource
